correctness.rationale: For a path/cycle component with order at most k, the complete component weakly blocks any split, so it must stay intact. For a component >k, splitting coalitions into induced connected pieces preserves utility. Any piece of length <k may absorb adjacent endpoint without utility decrease for either side and with one strict gain, forcing all pieces length k; divisibility follows. Conversely any deviation improving a boundary endpoint of a full k-block must keep its utility-two internal neighbors and recurse through the original block, requiring k+1 vertices. k=1/2 and cycle boundary cases handled. Larger cycles have k tiling offsets, paths one; intact small labeled components can merge subject to total weight ≤k and are counted by restricted multivariate Bell EGF. Independent direct checks gave P4,k3 0; P6,k3 1; C6,k3 3; edge plus two isolated,k3 4. No heterogeneous weights or maximum degree>2 covered.
